change: Bind shared stream read/write state admission to operation deadlines and make published write interruption memory-safe without synchronous retirement

reference.observed_contract: transport batches and cancellation callbacks retain call references until asynchronous completion; surface interruption does not require caller-stack storage to outlive the operation

before.reader: read ownership admission and cleanup used the unbounded State lock; cancellation joined retirement before returning
before.writer: State admission used the unbounded lock and the endpoint borrowed a stack Write command plus caller payload until completion
before.risk: operation deadlines could be exceeded by State ownership, while returning early after publication would create stack or payload use-after-return

admission_cases: read timeout while State is held
read executor cancellation while State is held
write timeout while State is held
write executor cancellation while State is held
published_interruption_cases: reader wait canceled after resetting its change event
writer wait canceled after publishing an endpoint-owned command

interop.shared_operation_case: held-State write/read 10 ms admission timeouts, same-duplex request/response retry, asynchronous cancellation, bounded retirement and same-channel unary reuse
